description: Jordan is the family media custodian for three boxes of old Hi8 videotapes and must decide how they will be transferred, protected, and shared after checking in with three relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family has three unlabeled Hi8 videotapes from the late 1990s, and Jordan is currently keeping them at home.
shared_context.S2: Jordan must finalize how the tapes will be transferred, stored, and made available to relatives.
shared_context.S3: The family wants digital copies while preserving the original tapes.
shared_context.S4: Before making the plan, Jordan's usual family check-in is for each person to say what they know or need considered.
shared_context.S5: The tapes include family gatherings and a recording made inside the grandparents' old house.

PF1.text: Mara spoke with Aunt Celia, who asked that tape 03 never be shared beyond Celia and Jordan because it includes a private conversation; this request has not reached the group.

PF2.text: Eli owns a working Digital8/Hi8 camcorder that can play these tapes and transfer them directly to a computer, so the family can use that camcorder rather than sending the tapes to a general conversion service.

PF3.text: Renee's archival contact recommended creating the digital masters as FFV1-encoded Matroska files, storing the originals in an acid-free box kept between 18 and 21 degrees Celsius, and transferring tape 02 first because it is the most fragile.

acceptance_conditions: The tapes must be transferred using Eli's working Digital8/Hi8 camcorder.
Tape 03 must be accessible only to Aunt Celia and Jordan.
The digital masters must use FFV1-encoded Matroska files.
The original tapes must be stored in an acid-free box kept between 18 and 21 degrees Celsius.
A commitment to use Eli's camcorder for the transfer must be recorded.
A commitment to restrict tape 03 access must be recorded.

decisive_facts.why: Celia's specific request changes tape 03 from ordinary family access to access restricted to Celia and Jordan and creates the required restriction commitment.
Eli's working camcorder changes the transfer method to the specifically named Digital8/Hi8 camcorder and creates the camcorder-transfer commitment.
Renee's archival recommendation changes the master format to FFV1 Matroska, the storage to an acid-free box at 18 to 21 degrees Celsius, and the first transfer to tape 02.
